cardOverview.overviewText: A Build Your Own Card (BYOC) product allowing customers to personalize their categories for accelerated rewards, offering flexibility and milestone perks.

benefitRows.name: Golf
benefitRows.offer: Complimentary access to golf games 4 times every year.|You also get 1 complimentary golf lesson each calendar month.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Access the designated golf booking portal using the email ID registered with your credit card. Choose your preferred golf course, date, and time, and complete the booking. You’ll receive a confirmation via email, take this with you when you play. Note that additional costs like caddy fees and carts are usually not covered and must be paid at the course.
